description: Known, accepted noise in the pm2 logs (scripts/log-sentinel.js). Each `pattern` is a case-insensitive regex tested against the sentinel's normalised fingerprint text (lowercase; integers -> N, hex -> H, paths -> /…, quoted strings -> "…"), so an entry survives small wording changes. A matching shape is still counted and listed on /admin/status under 'Log errors' (muted, 'known') but never colours the page. Shapes acknowledged from the page live in logs/log-sentinel/known.json instead. Remove an entry once the code that produced the noise is fixed, so a regression shows up as new again.

entries.pattern: foreign key constraint failed|failed to update stats for player n
entries.note: Live loop inserting player_stats for boxscore players absent from nfl_players (defensive players, non-draftable positions). ~4,400/day until nflGamesService.updatePlayerStatsFromBoxScore skips them up front (plan section D); remove this entry once that fix is deployed.
Daily player sync skipping Tank01 players with no position/team (practice-squad and inactive entries). Expected every 13:00 UTC sync; a counted summary line is the long-term fix.

entries.pattern: ^error: health alert \[|^error: - .*'s team: n active players|teams don't have n active players
entries.note: HealthCheckService logs every recorded alert (and its per-team lines) at error level. The alert itself is already on the Alerts card of /admin/status, so the log copy is not a call to action.

The watchdog, notifier and diagnosis scripts narrate every incident to stdout with the severity in the line. The live card on /admin/status is their real surface; the same lines in the log are not a second call to action.
Live play review summarises each pass ('done: warning — ...') and reports the local Qwen box being off (it lives on Joe's laptop). The live review card shows both; the log echo is noise.

entries.pattern: ^n suite\(s\) failed — details saved to|^suite "…": failed \(exit n\)
entries.note: Nightly test failures are the nightly-tests job's own status (red on the Jobs card); the stdout lines that describe them are not a new error shape.

entries.pattern: ^n file\(s\), n with new bytes, n error/warn entries;|^(new|spiking) \[[a-z-]+/(error|warn)\]
entries.note: The sentinel's own pass summary and NEW/SPIKING lines contain the words error/warn. They belong to the log-sentinel job; if they ever land in another job's log (an in-process run) they are not an error.
